sources.label: trailofbits
sources.pin_method: vendored-snapshot: citrate-labs .claude/ tree; every blob under plugins/ equals upstream at commit

sources.label: frontend-skills
sources.license: MIT (README statement, no LICENSE file); impeccable and hyperframes Apache-2.0; frontend-design own LICENSE.txt

frontend-skills/impeccable.reason: the body and references call bundled scripts through a {{scripts_path}} placeholder (context loader, live browser mode, pin); the Hermes loader does not substitute it and those steps cannot run stripped; the design guidance and reference docs still apply; owner to confirm or exclude

trailofbits/plugins/agentic-actions-audi.reason: flag hits are detection patterns the auditor looks for (agent sandbox flags, subshell vectors), not instructions to the agent

trailofbits/plugins/burpsuite-project-pa.reason: a wrapper around its bundled script (22 body references); nothing usable ships with the script stripped

trailofbits/plugins/claude-in-chrome-tro.reason: troubleshoots another agent host browser extension; not applicable to Hermes

trailofbits/plugins/culture-index/skills.reason: personality and hiring-profile analysis of people; outside every Hermes track and handles personal data

trailofbits/plugins/devcontainer-setup/s.reason: its bundled templates pipe remote installers into a shell and configure a coding agent with permission prompts bypassed; also specific to another agent host

trailofbits/plugins/firebase-apk-scanner.reason: a wrapper around a scanner script that lives outside the skill directory and actively probes third-party endpoints; nothing usable ships without it

trailofbits/plugins/let-fate-decide/skil.reason: injects random card draws into planning on vague prompts; conflicts with verifier-decided outcomes (D-22) and the interviewer (S1.4)

trailofbits/plugins/modern-python/skills.reason: flag hits are upstream installer one-liners quoted in reference docs; any shell step runs only through the gated shell tool

trailofbits/plugins/seatbelt-sandboxer/s.reason: the credential path appears in a negative test that the generated sandbox must deny

trailofbits/plugins/second-opinion/skill.reason: drives third-party model CLIs with their approval prompts turned off and sends code to external providers; conflicts with HIC levels and egress opt-in

trailofbits/plugins/skill-improver/skill.reason: edits skill files in an autonomous loop; conflicts with proposal-plus-accept self-learning (S3.4)

trailofbits/plugins/static-analysis/skil.reason: merge_sarif.py is a pure SARIF merge (it shells out only to an optional external merger); fits a WASM capsule; ships stripped until the capsule exists

trailofbits/plugins/testing-handbook-ski.reason: the pipe-to-shell hit is the upstream rustup installer quoted as a setup step; shell runs only through the gated shell tool

trailofbits/plugins/trailmark/skills/dia.reason: a wrapper around its bundled diagram script (8 body references); nothing usable ships with the script stripped

trailofbits/plugins/yara-authoring/skill.reason: credential-path hits are malware detection strings; the bundled linter and atom analyzer are pure functions over a rule file and fit a WASM capsule; ships stripped until the capsule exists

trailofbits/plugins/zeroize-audit/skills.reason: 25 bundled executables under tools/ drive the workflow (compiler emit and diff steps); stripped, its steps cannot run; revisit as a native toolset
